notes: Delete mirroring geography-replace-0002: removes 'Ottawa is the capital of Canada', a stored fact. The replace record's Lake Ontario query was phrased around the replacement (Toronto); rephrased around Ottawa ('Does the capital of Canada lie on the Ottawa River?') it would split, since a model may store that as a description of the capital, so the inverse query takes its place. Functional and inverse queries go only through the deleted fact: determinate (does not know). The four worlds carry over, re-derived.
